description: Where local CrowdSec bans come from: countries, autonomous systems, services, history

options.content: Local bans only, no blocklists. Approximate GeoIP locations. Max 30 days per view. Click an IP to filter the dashboard.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" [$__range]))

count(sum by (ip) (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" [$__range])) > 1)

count(sum by (country) (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" | country!="" [$__range])))

count(sum by (asn) (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" | asn!="" [$__range])))

count(sum by (module_id) (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" [$__range])))

topk(300, sum by (lat, lon, country) (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" | lat!="" [$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (country) (count_over_time({module_id=~"$crowdsec"} |= "export-alerts" | json SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, MESSAGE | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=~".+-export-alerts" | line_format "{{.MESSAGE}}" | json | __error__="" | v="2" | country=~"$country" | service=~"$service" | ip=~"$ip" | country!="" [$__range])))
